#- Chapter 13: Energy Efficiency

#-- Section BC 1301: General

#--- 1301.1 Scope.

This chapter governs the design and construction of buildings for energy efficiency.

#---- 1301.1.1 Criteria.

Buildings shall be designed and constructed in accordance with the New York City Energy Conservation Code.

Editor's note: For related unconsolidated provisions, see Appendix A at L.L. 2009/085.
